projectDescription: The work under this contract includes, but is not limited to, the selected Contractor performing crack and joint sealing, patching, leveling, milling, resurfacing, re-striping, re-marking, re-installation of permanent raised pavement markings, and incidental concrete work, as stated in Section 2 of the Contract and Exhibit “A,” on designated streets in the Town of China Grove as identified by the Public Works Department, including mobilizations and demobilizations; all labor including special subcontracting; permits, licenses, and certifications; tools, equipment, materials, and miscellaneous hardware; excavation and grading; hauling; traffic control and work zone safety operations; site security; infrastructure removals and resettings; incidental infrastructure relocations; removal of debris, cleanup, and disposal; seeding and mulching; testing; touch-up repairs; and all else required as necessary in accordance with the Contract documents to the satisfaction of the Director and the Town of China Grove.
